items.condition: A report claiming completed four-endpoint validation is missing reactant_1, product_3, im5 or water, uses wrong charge/multiplicity or changed identity, or asserts an unsupported minimum classification. An honest bounded failure may omit unavailable endpoints without claiming their validation.
Reports a free-energy result without reproducible method or validation evidence
Claims the endpoint calculation proves the complete reaction mechanism
Uses the unbalanced bare1-to-3 energy subtraction as a reaction energy, or silently conflates source-recipe arithmetic with a consistently corrected1M standard state
